name: Atom carrier inconsistencies
coverage: Indexed Atoms only; current index contains no Archived rows. Exact scope-to-folder/summary-slug derivation is not included.
sql:
-- Compare indexed Atom carrier facts; this query does not infer scope-to-folder rules.
WITH source AS (
  SELECT reference, status_group, "relative path" AS actual_path, filename AS actual_filename,
    "content.summary" AS summary,
    NULLIF(header_identity_atom_id, '') AS grouped_id,
    NULLIF(header_identity_id, '') AS alternate_id,
    NULLIF(header_atom_id, '') AS legacy_id,
    NULLIF(header_identity_ref_id, '') AS grouped_ref_id,
    NULLIF(header_ref_id, '') AS legacy_ref_id,
    NULLIF(header_state_status, '') AS grouped_status,
    NULLIF(header_status, '') AS legacy_status,
    header_state_version AS grouped_version, header_version AS legacy_version,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(header_context_role, ''), NULLIF(header_role, ''), header_content_role) AS role,
    header_destination_file_path AS grouped_path, header_carrier_destination_file_path AS legacy_path,
    header_destination_file_name AS grouped_name, header_carrier_destination_file_name AS legacy_name
  FROM atoms
), resolved AS (
  SELECT *, COALESCE(grouped_id, alternate_id, legacy_id) AS atom_id,
    COALESCE(grouped_ref_id, legacy_ref_id) AS stored_ref_id,
    COALESCE(grouped_version, legacy_version) AS version,
    COALESCE(grouped_status, legacy_status) AS status,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(grouped_path, ''), NULLIF(legacy_path, '')) AS stored_path,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(grouped_name, ''), NULLIF(legacy_name, '')) AS stored_filename
  FROM source
), expected AS (
  SELECT *, CASE
    WHEN status_group = 'Current' THEN atom_id
    WHEN status_group = 'Archived' AND version IS NOT NULL THEN atom_id || '@' || CAST(version AS VARCHAR)
    WHEN status_group = 'Draft' AND version IS NOT NULL THEN atom_id || '@' || CAST(version AS VARCHAR) || '-draft'
    END AS expected_ref_id,
    CASE WHEN lower(role) = 'plan' OR atom_id LIKE 'CA-P-%' THEN '([0-9]+-)?' ELSE '' END AS sequence_pattern
  FROM resolved
), audit AS (
  SELECT *, concat_ws('; ',
    CASE WHEN atom_id IS NULL THEN 'missing Atom ID' END,
    CASE WHEN grouped_id IS NOT NULL AND alternate_id IS NOT NULL AND grouped_id <> alternate_id THEN 'ID aliases disagree' END,
    CASE WHEN legacy_id IS NOT NULL AND ((grouped_id IS NOT NULL AND legacy_id <> grouped_id) OR (alternate_id IS NOT NULL AND legacy_id <> alternate_id)) THEN 'legacy/grouped ID disagree' END,
    CASE WHEN grouped_ref_id IS NOT NULL AND legacy_ref_id IS NOT NULL AND grouped_ref_id <> legacy_ref_id THEN 'Ref ID aliases disagree' END,
    CASE WHEN grouped_status IS NOT NULL AND legacy_status IS NOT NULL AND lower(grouped_status) <> lower(legacy_status) THEN 'Status aliases disagree' END,
    CASE WHEN grouped_version IS NOT NULL AND legacy_version IS NOT NULL AND grouped_version <> legacy_version THEN 'Version aliases disagree' END,
    CASE WHEN status IS NULL THEN 'missing Status' END,
    CASE WHEN version IS NULL OR version < 1 THEN 'missing/invalid Version' END,
    CASE WHEN stored_ref_id IS NULL THEN 'missing Ref ID' END,
    CASE WHEN expected_ref_id IS NOT NULL AND stored_ref_id IS NOT NULL AND stored_ref_id <> expected_ref_id THEN 'Ref ID disagrees with ID/Status Group/Version' END,
    CASE WHEN stored_path IS NULL THEN 'missing destination path' END,
    CASE WHEN stored_filename IS NULL THEN 'missing destination filename' END,
    CASE WHEN grouped_path IS NOT NULL AND legacy_path IS NOT NULL AND grouped_path <> legacy_path THEN 'destination path aliases disagree' END,
    CASE WHEN grouped_name IS NOT NULL AND legacy_name IS NOT NULL AND grouped_name <> legacy_name THEN 'destination filename aliases disagree' END,
    CASE WHEN stored_path IS NOT NULL AND actual_path IS DISTINCT FROM stored_path THEN 'actual directory differs from destination path' END,
    CASE WHEN stored_filename IS NOT NULL AND actual_filename IS DISTINCT FROM stored_filename THEN 'actual filename differs from destination filename' END,
    CASE WHEN stored_path IS NOT NULL AND (starts_with(stored_path, '/') OR regexp_matches(stored_path, '(^|/)\.\.(/|$)')) THEN 'destination path is not repository-relative' END,
    CASE WHEN stored_filename IS NOT NULL AND (contains(stored_filename, '/') OR contains(stored_filename, chr(92))) THEN 'destination filename includes a directory' END,
    CASE WHEN expected_ref_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT regexp_matches(actual_filename, '^' || sequence_pattern || regexp_escape(expected_ref_id) || '(-|\.)') THEN 'actual filename disagrees with identity/status/version' END,
    CASE WHEN expected_ref_id IS NOT NULL AND stored_filename IS NOT NULL AND NOT regexp_matches(stored_filename, '^' || sequence_pattern || regexp_escape(expected_ref_id) || '(-|\.)') THEN 'destination filename disagrees with identity/status/version' END,
    CASE WHEN NOT ends_with(actual_filename, '.md') THEN 'actual filename has no .md extension' END,
    CASE WHEN stored_filename IS NOT NULL AND NOT ends_with(stored_filename, '.md') THEN 'destination filename has no .md extension' END,
    CASE WHEN regexp_matches(actual_path, '(^|/)draft(/|$)') AND status_group <> 'Draft' THEN 'draft folder disagrees with Status Group' END,
    CASE WHEN regexp_matches(actual_path, '(^|/)(archive|archived)(/|$)') AND status_group <> 'Archived' THEN 'archive folder disagrees with Status Group' END
  ) AS inconsistencies
  FROM expected
)
SELECT reference, atom_id, status_group, status, version, role,
  actual_path, actual_filename, stored_path, stored_filename,
  stored_ref_id, expected_ref_id, inconsistencies
FROM audit WHERE inconsistencies <> ''
ORDER BY actual_path, actual_filename;

rows: Bind new archived Revision Markdown Carrier

The single Markdown Archive Carrier created for an Atom Revision newly placed in Archived status.


**when** an Atom Revision newly attains its model-admitted `Archived` Status **and** no more-specific applicable Delivery mapping exists for its Artifact Type, its **`=1`** Markdown Archive Carrier **must** be classified as that Revision's Archive Carrier **and** be placed at `archive/<canonical-ID>@<version>[-<remaining-filename-components>].md`: the owning Content Role's existing `archive/` directory is retained, and the single `@<version>` marker occupies the Atom-ID segment under CA-D-283/CA-D-289. Preserve the archived Atom's numeric Version and prior Updated At; its new Archive Carrier carries `status: Archived`.

identity continuity when a Draft Atom is created, updated or admitted to a non-Draft Status.


Draft identity continuity **must** follow the exact admitted target and the applicable identity rules; retained Draft history **must not** be a prerequisite for Create, Update, promotion, another admitted Status change or their success.

- do **not** require, reconstruct, register, resolve or validate a `revision_lineage.history_entry_ref`, unique Draft head, origin chain, direct retained-history parent, pending head reservation or consuming successor before an otherwise admitted effect. A manually authored Draft is not refused merely because those records are absent, incomplete, malformed or unavailable.
- Draft `atom_id` presence and marker form follow CA-D-378 and CA-D-446; Draft filename identity-segment serialization follows CA-D-650. Do **not** restore a former assigned Identity from an archive, lineage/origin metadata, Journal, prior tool demotion or another historical record. Preserve real historical identities without releasing them for reuse. Ordinary Content Role, Summary/replacement, identity/collision, expected-target/currentness, permission and Carrier/schema checks remain applicable; absence of retained Draft history is not itself an identity conflict.
- When a Current Atom revision is updated, preserve the predecessor's old numeric Version, Updated At and unrelated content while archiving it with `status: Archived` and the version-qualified identity; exact pre-archiv
